description: This Java source file defines a utility class for managing watch face customization settings on Wear OS devices. It provides methods for fetching, updating, and storing configuration data such as color settings, and handles communication with the wearable DataApi. The class encapsulates functionality related to synchronizing watch face style parameters via Google's Data API.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing watch face configuration data, including fetching, updating, and storing color settings via Google's Wearable Data API.

methods.name: parseColor
methods.description: Converts a color name string to an integer color value using Android's Color.parseColor().

methods.name: fetchConfigDataMap
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the current configuration DataMap from the wearable Data API.

methods.name: overwriteKeysInConfigDataMap
methods.description: Merges given configuration keys into the current configuration DataMap and updates the DataItem.

methods.name: putConfigDataItem
methods.description: Creates or updates the configuration DataItem with provided DataMap.
